note: Plano elected its mayor (Council Place 6) on 2013-05-11 under the four-year cycle in Charter Section 3.01(c). The Collin County official report and the Denton County official Clarity results were combined for the citywide totals. A majority elected the winner, so no runoff was held.

Plano elected its mayor (Council Place 6) on 2017-05-06 under the four-year cycle in Charter Section 3.01(c). The Collin County official report and the Denton County official Clarity results were combined for the citywide totals. A majority elected the winner, so no runoff was held.

Plano elected its mayor (Council Place 6) on 2021-05-01 under the four-year cycle in Charter Section 3.01(c). The Collin County official report and the Denton County official Clarity results were combined for the citywide totals. A majority elected the winner, so no runoff was held.

Plano holds its mayoral election in May of 2013, 2017, 2021 and 2025 (Charter Section 3.01(c)). The Collin County official report shows John Muns as the only candidate, with 14,611 votes. Denton County official Clarity results for May 3, 2025 (id 123614) and the runoff (id 123838) list no City of Plano contest, so the Denton part of Plano is not confirmed. The citywide total is not established, so the year stays unresolved. Plano.gov election pages returned HTTP 404 and votedenton.gov returned a bot challenge (HTTP 202).
